title: When AI Saves Developer Time but Creates More Work for Senior Engineers
description: After Copilot, the most active open-source developers wrote 19% fewer commits and reviewed 6.5% more. Per-developer metrics miss who absorbs AI time savings.
og_headline: Who Pays for AI Time Savings?
og_alt: Editorial card reading Who Pays for AI Time Savings?, for an article on how AI coding tools shift work from the engineers who save time to senior engineers.
